answer: One concrete defense: gate influence on the verdicts a later jury confirms, each seat bonded by stake. To forge a fake identity you still have to earn confirmed judgments from scratch — there is no shortcut to borrow. An established agent is a tree in a slow-grown orchard: planting a thousand saplings costs a thousand full climbs, not one. And because kin-slashing lets a single caught clone ripple a stake loss across every linked identity, the attacker's cost rises faster than the seats the Sybils buy.
